Source: mdurl 0.3.1 from crates.io (upstream commit 0a7536e3ffc7f5688d3b06ab647ebcfbc511d1cb).
License: MIT; see LICENSE and the notices retained in individual source files.

The original upstream tests are unchanged. Cargo.toml updates the idna requirement to
1.1.0 to remove RUSTSEC-2024-0421 from the dependency graph. Two Cow return
types explicitly spell their inferred lifetimes for current Rust compilers;
they do not change encoding behavior. URL parsing calculates malformed-host
suffixes relative to the trimmed input and restores extracted ports to that
suffix without duplicating them. tests/security.rs covers multibyte input,
trimming, and port preservation; the old calculation could panic at a UTF-8
boundary or discard input bytes.
The latest published upstream mdurl release still requires idna <0.4.
A Cargo patch selects this copy while preserving mdurl's permissive URL
parsing and encoding behavior. Replace it with an upstream release when
upstream supports a fixed idna version.
